newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin looks relaxed, fairly well on television.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin looks relaxed, fairly well on television.

text.p: Boris Yeltsin looked tanned and relaxed in brief silent footage released by Russian Television showing the president meeting Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin in hospital on Tuesday.

Yeltsin, whose spokesman said he would spend the rest of the week in Moscow's Central Clinical Hospital for tests ahead of a heart operation, smiled and gestured with both arms as he sat chatting with the premier in a sequence lasting about a minute.

Yeltsin, wearing an open-necked white shirt and grey patterned knitted cardigan, was filmed going over papers with the besuited Chernomyrdin, to whom he has handed some responsibilties as he prepares for heart bypass surgery.
Kremlin spokesman Sergei Yastrzhembsky said on Tuesday that Yeltsin, who was originally said to be spending just last weekend in hospital, would now probably be there all week.
He denied speculation the 65-year-old leader's condition had worsened, however, citing the hour-long meeting with Chernomyrdin as evidence.
Yeltsin's doctors, including some foreign heart specialists, are due to meet on September 25 or 26 to decide when the operation should go ahead.
